Name: PortaNet AG
Description:
Das Schweizer Unternehmen PortaNet AG mit Sitz in Emmen/Luzern digitalisiert Fenster und Türen. Die erhobenen Daten werden sämtlichen Nutzern in der Cloud-Applikation MyPortaNet  jederzeit online zur Verfügung gestellt. Nicht nur Immobilienbesitzer und -verwalter profitieren von unzähligen Vorteilen, sondern auch Tür- und Fensterhersteller mit ihrem Servicebetrieb, Facility-Management-Unternehmen und alle Personen, die sich mit Fenster und Türen beschäftigen. 

Die digitale Lösung MyPortaNet misst, steuert, dokumentiert und automatisiert den kompletten Lebenszyklus von Fenster und Türen mit statischen Informationen wie auch mit dynamischen Meldungen zur Nutzung, zu Störungen oder zu Wartungsaktivitäten. Ist ein Service fällig oder steht eine Türe offen, die geschlossen sein sollte, signalisiert das System automatisch den Handlungsbedarf oder meldet den Status. Dank des digitalen Informationsarchivs können Sie jederzeit und überall auf alle individuellen Elementinformationen per App zugreifen. Damit revolutioniert die cloudbasierte Prozessautomatisierung das Fenster- und Türmanagement für Sie, den Besitzer, Verwalter oder Hersteller. 

Die Echtzeitinformationen geben Kunden und Wartungspartnern den entscheidenden Wissensvorsprung für die proaktive, effiziente und nutzungsgerechte Planung und Ausführung sämtlicher Aktivitäten und Ressourcen. Unser System ist in der Lage, selbständig einen Service auszulösen, Nutzungsdaten für die Planung oder die Abrechnung zu liefern oder bei Bedarf zu alarmieren, falls ein Objekt zu einer bestimmten Zeit zu lange offen steht. Unsere Daten sind zudem nützlich bei Garantie- und Versicherungsfällen.

Die MyPortaNet-Lösung basiert auf einer Cloud-Software und neuester IoT-Technologie (LoRaWANTM / Sigfox), dem Sensor «CycleCounter», sowie dem QID-Tag.

Name: QiSquared
Description:

Our platform builds on this logic focusing on corporate filings in order to (i) prove our hypothesis and (ii) showcase the inherent benefits of its principles i.e., reveal financial manipulation and deception buried in hundreds of pages of financial reports. 

Our AaaS platform can tap government ledgers, break down the captured datapoints and rebuild data sets into a “feed” for our engine room of proprietary algorithms to deliver any time, any place, on any device, fast real-time, clear insights into company, sector, and economic performance.
AI cannot do what we do, because the technology is truly deep tech. 

We developed our MVP over 5 years, and have succeeded where others – such as MIT (who have been working on this issue for several years), Microsoft/Refinitiv, Bloomberg and Google - had failed. 

As a disruptor, we are seeking partnering investors to take the company to its next stage of development. Additional information can be found on our website.

Name: BIZ Schaffhausen Berufsberatung Studienberatung Laufbahnberatung
Description:
Wie soll es beruflich weitergehen?

Vielleicht ist jetzt der Moment, etwas zu verändern. Du möchtest dich weiterentwickeln, eine Weiterbildung ins Auge fassen, nach einer Pause wieder einsteigen oder herausfinden, welche beruflichen Möglichkeiten noch in dir stecken. Vielleicht suchst du keine fertigen Antworten, sondern jemanden, der dich dabei unterstützt, deinen eigenen Weg zu finden.

Genau dafür sind wir da.

Im BIZ Schaffhausen begleiten wir Menschen in Phasen der beruflichen Veränderung. Wir schaffen Raum für neue Gedanken, stellen Fragen, die weiterbringen, und helfen dir dabei, Möglichkeiten zu entdecken, die zu dir, deinem Leben und deinen Zielen passen.

Jeder Mensch bringt eine eigene Geschichte, Erfahrungen und Stärken mit. Deshalb gibt es nicht den einen richtigen Weg. Wir nehmen uns Zeit, zuzuhören, gemeinsam hinzuschauen und neue Sichtweisen zu entwickeln.

Dabei geht es nicht darum, dir vorzugeben, welchen Weg du einschlagen sollst. Es geht darum, dich zu stärken, damit du deine nächsten Schritte mit Klarheit und Zuversicht gehen kannst.

Ob berufliche Neuorientierung, Weiterbildung, Wiedereinstieg oder Laufbahnplanung, wir sind an deiner Seite und unterstützen dich dabei, deine berufliche Zukunft aktiv zu gestalten.

Denn manchmal braucht es nicht sofort eine Antwort.

Manchmal braucht es jemanden, der mit dir neue Möglichkeiten entdeckt.

A holistic perspective shall support the discussion and progress of medium and long term solutions.

Mobility is of great importance to the population and economy. Switzerland is an open economy that has to comply with todays’ requirements of mobility and accessibility in order to remain competitive. It is therefore essential for our country, to have a perfectly well working transportation of cargo and passengers – on rails, on streets and in the air.

Compared to international standards Switzerland is doing fine. What about the future of mobility though? How can the growing needs of traffic be satisfied? What infrastructures are required? How can we increase the efficiency of mobility and our mobility behavior with inventive technology? In short; Switzerland is facing big and exciting challenges.

Today’s debate on transport policy is often directed by individual interests. The holistic perspective that is concerned about how mobility shall be organized in the long term, maintained and financed is missed out.

For this reason, Dr. Hans Werder, former MP and Urs Hany, Infra Suisse-President, Prof. Matthias Finger and Fredy Müller established the dialogue platform AVENIR MOBILITÉ | ZUKUNFT MOBILITÄT. Their claim is to encourage the exchange between various actors of the sectors economy, trade associations, authorities, politics, science and the interested public.

Name: NewsQuant
Description:
The world runs on critical resources. Energy, metals, and agriculture. When one is disrupted, an offshore platform is evacuated, a strike at a mine, a grain export ban, markets reprice quickly. The first account appears in the news, usually well ahead of official statistics.

NewsQuant turns that first account into structured event intelligence for the physical economy. Our engine reads hundreds of thousands of news items a day, keeps what matters for commodities, and folds each story's retellings into one fact, timestamped at first mention, located, measured, and sorted by what it does to supply and demand. Each fact is weighed by the asset behind it. Which pipeline moves how much, which refinery or smelter holds what capacity, which region grows what share of the harvest, what share of seaborne trade passes each strait. The weights move as the world does, so every event is valued at the weight of its day.

Each record joins an archive of three decades of licensed premium news and over 100 million classifications, queryable and backtestable. It stores the world as it stood on each day, never in hindsight, so today's disruption can be compared with the moments that resembled it. Every score traces to the exact words that produced it.

Around the news sit the numbers. Supply, demand, and positioning data from the EIA, USDA, and CFTC, decades of minute-level futures prices, weather from stations to satellites, regulator disclosures, and real-money odds from prediction markets, all aligned in time to the fine-grained events that only news can provide, so patterns and agreements across diverse sources surface.

The research behind NewsQuant's technology spans award-winning, high-impact publications. What began as the world's first language model for crude oil news is now an event intelligence stack across the major commodities, selected by Switzerland's most competitive innovation programs (SNSF BRIDGE, Innosuisse, Venture Kick).

Swiss precision. newsquant.com

Name: PLR International
Description:
PLR International brings together lending rights stakeholders from across the globe to foster the exchange of best practices as well as provide support to countries to create or improve existing Public Lending Right (PLR) systems. PLRI had been operating as an informal global network since 1995. Background: The Public Lending Right (PLR) is the right of authors and other rightsholders to receive a fair payment for public lending by and in public libraries. The inclusion of authors’ works in public libraries forms the bedrock of the free exchange of ideas and the payment for the inclusion of that work is essential to support the creative and publishing sector. 

Thirty-three countries have PLR systems, but with varied terms and recognition of stakeholders. The formation of PLRI may help to expand the creation of PLR systems as well as make uniform these terms for authors, illustrators, and publishers around the world. These systems are generally funded by the central or regional government, not libraries themselves. 

The founding organisations of PLRI are EVA (European Visual Artists), EWC (European Writers’ Council), FEP (Federation of European Publishers), IPA (International Publishers Association) and three collective management organisations active in the collection and distribution of public lending rights: Reprobel (Belgium), La Sofia (France) and Stichting Leenrecht (The Netherlands). The new association, now jointly established by the international book sector’s federations formally under Swiss law with its headquarters in Geneva, will organize a PLR International Conference in 2026. Organisations and Associations can apply for membership (regular and affiliated).

Die Stiftung Doku-Zug ist eine gemeinnützige und steuerbefreite Stiftung mit Sitz in der Stadt Zug.

Die Stiftung kann ihren Zweck unter anderem mit folgenden Mitteln verfolgen:
-	Ausübung oder Unterstützung von Tätigkeiten, welche der Förderung zeitgeschichtlicher Forschung dienen, insbesondere über Themen, die mit der Region Zug verbunden sind;
-	Förderung des Meinungsaustausches zu Themen von öffentlichem Interesse, insbesondere durch die Durchführung oder Unterstützung von Konferenzen, Seminaren, Weiterbildungsveranstaltungen und Ausstellungen;
-	Unterstützung der Erstellung oder Veröffentlichung von Publikationen, insbesondere Dissertationen, Master-, Bachelor- und Maturaarbeiten durch Beiträge, Stipendien oder Preise.

Diese Aufzählung ist beispielhaft und nicht abschliessend. Der Stiftungsrat kann im eigenen Ermessen Schwerpunkte setzen.

Name: KIIO
Description:
Chemical and other process manufacturing plants operate 24/7, and each hour of unplanned downtime can cost over $100,000. To keep plants running continuously, machines are monitored by sensors. However, studies show that over 80% of equipment failures are caused by abnormal processes rather than equipment end-of-life. By the time such faults are detected, it is often too late for operators to act. Today, process diagnosis is still largely manual: it takes a team of specialists to enumerate, test, and eliminate hypotheses one by one, a time-consuming and labor-intensive procedure that can take weeks or months.

This challenge is amplified by the fact that 20% of the chemical industry workforce will retire by 2030, taking decades of operational knowledge with them. New operators urgently require intuitive, explainable diagnostic support to ensure efficient and reliable operations. Currently, no effective solution exists for process-level monitoring and diagnosis to improve reliability. The result is lost productivity: chemical plants run at an average of only 41% overall equipment effectiveness, meaning that half of the potential capacity is lost to downtime, inefficiencies, or off-spec production, translating into hundreds of millions in annual costs for a typical large plant.

KIIO has developed technology that shifts monitoring from isolated assets to the full process by treating the plant as a connected network. By learning the relationships among sensor signals and tracking subtle changes as they occur, KIIO detects abnormal processes earlier - before they develop into equipment faults. The technology does not rely on fault libraries (a database of known failures) but learns directly from real-time data. Importantly, KIIO doesn’t just point out deviations from the norm; it also shows how a fault propagates through the process and helps engineers and operators understand where a problem may have started and how it can be mitigated.

ogram combines classical agentic techniques, including skills, plug-ins, connectors, retrieval, source-grounding, and harness engineering, with proprietary infrastructure such as ogram streams, optimized parsing and extraction services, domain-specific compression algorithms, and drift-reduction techniques for long-running tasks.

We are provider-portable by design. Clients should be able to use OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source models, and future providers without rebuilding their knowledge layer each time the market shifts. The model can change. The client’s expertise should remain portable.

We also treat skill portability as a strategic requirement. Skills are where institutional know-how lives. They should not be trapped inside one vendor’s interface, model family, or cloud environment.

ogram is for organizations where reliability, sovereignty, confidentiality, and zero-data-retention deployment patterns matter. We build the infrastructure that turns raw tokens into context-specific, auditable, high-value intelligence.

Description:

Escaro turns tacit human knowledge into a structured, searchable and connected asset. Using AI-supported interviews and intelligent knowledge graphs, Escaro captures expertise directly from employees and links it to existing documents, processes and context.

The result is a living knowledge base that evolves with the organization — not another static wiki.

Built with HR, IT and transformation teams in mind, Escaro supports:

Knowledge retention and succession planning

Reduced dependency on individuals

Faster onboarding and role transitions

Organizational continuity during growth, change or exit

Escaro follows a “knowledge escrow” approach: knowledge remains owned, governed and accessible by the organization, while staying human-centric, transparent and secure.

Designed for enterprises in regulated and complex environments, Escaro integrates into existing workflows and prioritizes trust, simplicity and long-term value over short-term automation.

Escaro helps organizations ensure that what matters most — human expertise — is not lost, but preserved for the future.

All'inizio la società intesa come forma giuridica non esisteva, venne creato solo un sito web tramite piattaforma CSM su server Italiano.
Il sito inizialmente si occupava solamente di recupero dati cancellati da cellulari, attività che tutt'ora il Dott.Lunardi prosegue in qualità di Consulente Tecnico per diverse procure.
Creato il sito web servivano le attrezzature e così Lunardi si rivolse a Paraben Ltd www.paraben.com dove acquistò con diversi sacrifici (dati i costi non propriamente economici degli hardware/software)tutto il materiale per iniziare l'attività.
Da quel giorno sono seguite molte altre richieste e nel settembre 2010 Lunardi mantenendo la vecchia P.I. di cui disponeva come ditta individuale creò Indagini Informatico Forensi srl.
Dal 2009 Lunardi parallelamente all'attività nella DIGITAL FORENSICS iniziò incitato da un vecchio investigatore privato di Savona(ora in pensione)l'attività di recupero DATI SENSIBILI e SPIONAGGIO INFORMATICO,fu subito chiaro che tale attività per trovare un riscontro oggettivo ed economico necessitava di canali preferenziali e molte conoscenze nei più svariati campi sia nazionali che internazionali.
Tutto ciò e molto altro fa sì che oggi Indagini Informatico Forensi srl di cui il marchio brevettato sia una delle poche realtà Italiane nell'elaborazione dei dati sensibili.

Description:

Et pourtant ! Nombreux sont ceux à considérer le Moyen âge comme une période « sombre », d’obscurantisme religieux, de violence, et à lui associer toutes sortes de clichés peu flatteurs. C’est là qu’intervient Le Scriptorium, qui a pour vocation de redonner ses lettres de noblesse à cette période extrêmement riche de l’histoire occidentale.

Et si la science pouvait voyager là où on ne l’attend pas ?

Dans une époque où les opinions se polarisent, où les questions de santé, d’environnement et de technologies façonnent notre quotidien sans toujours être comprises, l’association SODA – Science Ouverte Démocratisée et Accessible – s’est donné une mission simple et urgente : réintroduire du lien, du sens et de la confiance entre la Science et la Société.

Enseignant·e·s, chercheur·se·s et vulgarisateur·rice·s scientifiques, nous parcourons les territoires – maisons de jeunes, quartiers, centres sociaux, lieux fermés ou isolés – avec une conviction forte : l’accessibilité aux sciences doit être plus équitable. 

Nos actions sont itinérantes, inclusives et co-construites : ateliers mobiles, expériences collectives, jeux-débats,... Chaque rencontre devient un espace de dialogue et d’exploration où chacun, quel que soit son parcours, peut manipuler, questionner, débattre, comprendre.

Notre objectif : ouvrir des portes là où elles sont souvent fermées et permettre à des publics traditionnellement éloignés – notamment les jeunes – de s’emparer des sujets qui façonnent l’avenir :

•	 Susciter le goût de la science par l’expérimentation
•	 Éveiller l’esprit critique dans un monde saturé d’informations
•	 Donner des clés pour comprendre les grands enjeux contemporains : santé, climat, biodiversité, numérique, IA...
•	 Renforcer la confiance et la capacité d’agir

En allant vers les publics, plutôt que l’inverse, SODA espère contribuer à son échelle, à une science plus ouverte, plus vivante, plus démocratique — une science qui circule, qui écoute et qui se transforme au contact de celles et ceux qu’elle rencontre.

Avec SODA, sors de ta bulle et viens faire pétiller la science avec nous !

Les actions

Name: Dabu Flow AG
Description:
DabuFlow AG bietet mit DabuSoft Pro eine umfassende Business-Software, die speziell auf die Bedürfnisse von kleinen und mittleren Unternehmen (KMU) in der Schweiz zugeschnitten ist. Unsere Lösung erleichtert die Digitalisierung und Integration von Geschäftsprozessen und schafft somit Effizienz und Transparenz in der Unternehmenssteuerung.

Kernmodule und Funktionen:
-Enterprise Resource Planning (ERP): DabuSoft Pro unterstützt Unternehmen in der Auftragsbearbeitung, Produktionsplanung und Lagerverwaltung. Vom Bestelleingang bis zur Rechnungsstellung ermöglicht das ERP-Modul eine durchgehende Prozesssteuerung und -optimierung.
-Customer Relationship Management (CRM): Das integrierte CRM-Modul bietet umfassende Möglichkeiten zur Verwaltung von Kundenbeziehungen, von der Adressverwaltung bis hin zu E-Mail-Marketingkampagnen. Dies ermöglicht eine effiziente und personalisierte Kundenbetreuung.
-E-Commerce: Mit der nahtlosen Integration von Shopify unterstützt DabuSoft Pro den Online-Vertrieb über mehrere Kanäle. So können Unternehmen ihre Reichweite erweitern und effizienter Bestellungen bearbeiten.
-Kurs- und Veranstaltungsmanagement: Unser Modul zur Kursverwaltung erleichtert die Organisation von Seminaren, Kursen und Messen. Es bietet flexible Möglichkeiten zur Teilnehmerverwaltung und Abrechnung.
-Personal- und Finanzmanagement: Funktionen zur Zeiterfassung, Lohnbuchhaltung und Spesenabrechnung unterstützen die Personalabteilung. Zudem ermöglicht das Kreditorenmanagement inklusive E-Banking-Schnittstellen eine effiziente Finanzverwaltung.

DabuSoft Pro zeichnet sich durch hohe Flexibilität und Individualisierbarkeit aus. Unternehmen können die Software durch benutzerdefinierte Workflows, eigene Druckvorlagen und spezialisierte Module exakt an ihre Bedürfnisse anpassen.

Mit DabuSoft Pro erhalten KMUs eine leistungsfähige, flexible Lösung, die die Digitalisierung von Geschäftsprozessen vorantreibt, administrative Aufgaben reduziert und die Effizienz steigert.

Name: AGILEC SARL
Description:
AGILEC is a Geneva based legal & compliance advisor company. It offers complex legal and compliance support in the financial and pharamceutic industry. Its develops softwares in order to monitor and mitigate your compliance risks. 
A compliance monitoring programm (CMP) is a tool that allows the top management to have control over the regulatory risk in a company. Legally it's supported by the Swiss Code of Obligations, by Basel II and ISO normes. SOX as well as most Corporate Governance documentation require and support a performing CMP.

But what is a CMP?

The general objective of a compliance process in terms of an internal control system (but not limited to statements of income) is the respect of law and regulation and as well as maintaining high ethical practices in any kind of organization. The objectives are of three kinds: minimizing risk, optimizing processes, improving efficiency.
As a reminder, we note that the term "compliance" in English means respect of the underlying business with a set of standards within an organization. 


These standards may be of regulatory or contractual basis. They can also be a source of self-regulation. You have to imagine a mirror between operational activity and regulatory standards. The ultimate goal is that the gap between the normative system and the operational activity is as low as possible.
It includes all sectors and workflows and covers all companies in an organization and all laws applicable.

At GoldKom, we help organizations deploy AI responsibly by embedding compliance, privacy, and ethical assurance into the heart of their technical and operational systems. We bridge the gap between policy and practice, ensuring that innovation never comes at the expense of trust.

We believe regulation and innovation don’t have to be at odds, they just need clear translation. Our approach is straightforward: start with business value, streamline processes, design controls that work in practice, and integrate those controls directly into the operating model.

With a background in political science and business communications, Sara began her career translating technical content for global corporations, later moving into policy and project roles in Brussels and internationally. Early in her career, she realized the real challenges weren’t in the algorithms, they were in the gaps between engineering teams, legal frameworks, and business users. Over time, she learned to speak “nerd,” legalese, and boardroom language, and bridge them all.

At heart, she delivers three key outcomes:
* Strategic clarity – Aligning AI and digital initiatives with measurable business outcomes.
* Operational rigor – Turning policies and frameworks into workflows, dashboards, and team accountability.
* Executive assurance – Equipping boards with the evidence, language, and governance to trust AI outcomes.

Sara leads clients from policy intent to system-level assurance across AI, privacy, and security, resulting in compliant, explainable, and efficient systems for boards, employees, regulation. She also writes, publishes, and advises on trends including the EU AI Act, algorithmic governance, and data ethics.
